title: Cost Estimating
desc: Order-of-magnitude, preconstruction, GMP, and change order estimating across all trades for a wide range of sectors. Services include owner's representative cost consultancy, bid leveling, lease term analysis, procurement support, and pricing of construction claims. Trade fluency in Architectural · MEP · Hazardous Removals · Vertical Transportation · Heavy Civil · Utilities

title: Change Management
desc: Change entitlement analysis, scope definition, and reconciliation of contractor proposals against independent cost estimates prepared on behalf of agencies. Deliverables developed for the contractual record.

title: Procurement
desc: Long-lead equipment tracking, A/E fee analysis, bid leveling, and vendor negotiation. Procurement schedules built backwards from installation milestones to protect schedule.

title: Project Controls
desc: Estimating, cost management, and scheduling competencies applied to measure project performance against forecast and to identify and manage commercial risks and opportunities. Experience includes reviewing contractor baseline schedules, validating monthly progress, maintaining independent cost reports against the capital plan, forecasting EAC, tracking contingency drawdown, auditing certified payroll, and processing change orders and contractor payments.
